_meta.description: Global-shop offer contents at TEMPLATE level, from the APK bundles. Template + quantity only; per-purchase stats (durability, grade, arcaneTier, properties) are rolled by the server, not stored here.

kinds.chest_roll: contents come from a chest -- server rolls it (chest_loots.json)
kinds.literal: currencies/stackables only -- can be granted verbatim
kinds.needs_roll: contains gear or jewellery -- server must roll instance stats
kinds.unclassified: contains a template not classifiable from these bundles

sources.bucket: captured purchase responses (which wire key a template landed in) + item_durability.json for gear never seen sold

_meta.verified: APK contents match captured purchase responses on 146/146 offers where both exist (summed across items+stackableItems+currencies)
